name: Homemade Flour Tortillas
desc: Soft butter flour tortillas made with hot water and a little baking powder.

source.title: Homemade Flour Tortillas
source.evidence: Saved Instagram reel; caption and on-screen text captured in the owner's saved-recipes export

ingredients.raw: 3 cups all-purpose flour, plus more for rolling
1 tsp neutral oil, for the skillet

steps: In a large bowl, whisk the flour, baking powder and salt.
Add the butter and rub it into the flour with your fingertips until no large pieces remain and the mix looks crumbly.
Stir in the hot water until a shaggy dough forms, then knead on the counter 3 to 5 minutes until smooth and soft.
Cover the dough with a towel or plastic wrap and rest 10 to 15 minutes.
Divide into 12 equal balls and keep them covered. On a lightly floured surface, roll one ball into a thin round about 8 inches across, almost see-through.
Heat a large skillet (cast iron or nonstick) over medium heat and wipe it with a little oil. Cook each tortilla 30 to 45 seconds per side, until it puffs and has light brown spots.
Stack the cooked tortillas in a clean kitchen towel to keep them warm and soft while you roll and cook the rest.
tips: Roll the next tortilla while the one in the pan cooks.
Most published versions rest the dough 30 minutes; a longer rest makes it easier to roll thin.
